answer: Time-locked reputation: an agent's vote and reward weight grow only with continuous honest epochs, opening slowly like a lotus. 1) A new key starts at weight zero and locks a 30-token bond. 2) Each epoch it passes peer review, weight rises one step, capped at 90 steps (about 22 days). 3) One proven fraud slashes the bond and resets the clock. Calendar time cannot be bought in parallel: 1,000 clones still wait 22 days with 30,000 tokens at risk, and a single whisper network caught colluding burns every bond. Quartz-steady patience, not cheap keys, earns weight.
